lines.text: I used to shrink myself to fit inside their frame
Quiet smiles, perfect lines, playing their game
But something inside me finally woke up loud
I’m stepping out the shadows, no more hiding now
I’ve got fire in my veins and I’m not afraid to show
Watch me shine, watch me glow
No more hiding, no more playing small
I’m standing tall, I’m breaking through the wall
This is my moment, this is my time
No more hiding, watch me come alive
Yeah, I’m done hiding, done hiding
They can talk, they can stare, doesn’t matter anymore
I’m writing my own story on an open door
Every scar, every fear, turned into strength today
I’m owning every piece of who I am this way
I’ve got fire in my veins and I’m not afraid to show
Watch me shine, watch me glow
No more hiding, no more playing small
I’m standing tall, I’m breaking through the wall
This is my moment, this is my time
No more hiding, watch me come alive
Yeah, I’m done hiding, done hiding
This is my life, my rules, my light
No more hiding, no more playing small
I’m standing tall, I’m breaking through the wall
This is my moment, this is my time
No more hiding, watch me come alive
Yeah, I’m done hiding, done hiding
